name: Providence Island
subtitle: Providence Island, in the mouth of the Mesurado, is where the founders of Monrovia first arrived in 1822 as part of an American Colonization Society mission.

parts.text: Providence Island, in the mouth of the Mesurado, is where the founders of Monrovia first arrived in 1822 as part of an American Colonization Society mission. A cultural center now stands there.
